text: A student determines the mass M of a metre rule using a balancing method.
The student uses the apparatus shown in Fig. 4.1.
• places the 100 g mass and the 50 g mass at distance a from each end of the metre rule,
• balances the metre rule with the pivot at position p on the metre rule
• calculates b, the distance between the 50 cm mark of the metre rule and the pivot
• records the values of a, p and b in Table 4.1.
The student repeats the procedure for a = 10.0 cm, 15.0 cm, 20.0 cm and 25.0 cm.
